messages:
sam-cs: Heads-up — DeepGreen Analytics renewal window next Fri. They want a short 4-month bridge term (start 2026-05-01) while they finish procurement for a larger 12mo commit. Asking for a 15% one-time credit (not ongoing discount) + 2 enablement credits. Procurement needs our EU vendor code and prefers card-on-file but CFO may insist on wire. Also asked for a data-residency addendum for EU processing. Need alignment on credit vs discount accounting and the signature/payment path. cc @mona-fin @kevin-legal @tara-enable

eli-se: Onboarding status: 90% — SSO + ingest validated. Only remaining is a final compliance attestation. No perf issues, but they want the bridge faster so cutover can't wait.

mona-fin: Give me seat count and baseline list price and I'll run the numbers. Also we need to decide whether the 15% is applied as a credit on this invoice or as a future renewal credit (affects revenue recognition).

sam-cs: Seat count 30; baseline list is $200/seat/month. They asked that the 15% be a credit applied to this invoice.

mona-fin: Math quick check: 30 * 200 * 4 = 24,000 pre-credit. 15% credit = 3,600. Net due = 20,400. If they want monthly invoices, that's 5,100/month pre-credit, or we can invoice one upfront for 20,400 and note credit applied. Finance prefers upfront when customers prepay, but monthly is ok with card-on-file. If they pay by wire we usually accept single invoice or monthly — either fine but need PO with billing entity.

kevin-legal: Data-residency addendum: we can include a short clause limiting processing of EU personal data to EU-hosted regions and requiring standard contractual clauses where necessary. KMS/HSM not requested here, right? Also, signature: DocuSign is fine for them. If CFO requires wet-sign for treasury, we accept secure-upload. Need signatory authority on the PO.

sam-cs: They said KMS not part of this deal. CFO flagged treasury policy and wants a wire option; procurement prefers card.

tara-enable: Enablement: can run two sessions (admin + hands-on) during week of 2026-05-04 provided PO in and payment method confirmed. Also they asked for a 1-page "first-48-hours" runbook which I can produce by 2026-04-28.

eli-se: Recommend we allow a temporary dedicated slot for the 2-week cutover window to avoid cold-cache latencies. Ops cost is minimal but we should note it as an uplift if they extend.

mona-fin: Decision needed: credit vs discount. Accounting prefers discount because credits tied to future invoices complicate recognition if customer churns. But product asked for one-time credit now — if we do credit applied to the current invoice, accounting treats it similarly to a discount if it's applied at billing time. I'll ok either if PO + payment method confirmed.

contract-bot: ContractGen: prepared 4-month addendum draft at https://contracts.redwood.com/drafts/DEEP-bridge-6337001234 v1 — includes credit language: "One-time credit of 15% to be applied to amounts invoiced under this addendum."

kevin-legal: I'll tweak the addendum to include the EU data residency clause and signature fallback: "Where customer treasury policy prohibits third-party electronic signature, customer may upload signed wet-scan to our secure portal and notify LegalOps." Also require signatory title on PO.

sam-cs: Customer just replied: will try card-on-file, but CFO may push wire. They want the credit applied immediately to this bridge invoice. PO ETA: EOD Thu.

mona-fin: If PO + card-on-file in by EOD Thu we approve the 15% credit applied now and will issue single invoice for the bridge term. If they insist on monthly invoices and wire, finance needs PO with billing entity and wire details; we'll split into monthly invoices with credit applied evenly across first invoice.

eli-se: I'll hold the canary rollout until enablement + payment confirmed. Also tagging infra to reserve dedicated slot for 2026-05-01->2026-05-14.

tara-enable: Noted. I'll prepare the runbook and block sessions pending signed PO.

kevin-legal: Action items: I'll post final addendum in contract thread by EOD Wed; include signature fallback and data residency.

mona-fin: Action: await PO + payment method; I'll prepare billing instructions and wire template if needed.

sam-cs: Plan recap: 1) Customer to provide PO (with billing entity + signatory title) by EOD Thu; 2) Finance to confirm invoice cadence & payment path; 3) Legal to post addendum (includes 15% one-time credit applied to bridge invoice) by EOD Wed; 4) Enablement & infra to prep for week of 2026-05-04; 5) Sam to update renewal tracker once PO uploaded. Closing loop here once PO & payment confirmed. Thanks team :thumbsup:
